opening.argument: The video presents a supportive housing program through a participant’s account of the stability and family connection it provides. One speaker says, “I would still be on the street trying to figure out what my next move would be,” while another explains, “Now that I have a stable environment, my son can come visit.” The program is identified as supporting “Volunteers of America’s flexible supportive housing programs,” and the visuals identify its intake coordinator and display the Wells Fargo and Volunteers of America logos together. These are cues of a program testimonial about housing and services, not a request for money or personal data. The account describes benefits of receiving housing, but does not present a financial or data solicitation.
